sigma_rules.title: Suspicious Process Access of MsMpEng by WerFaultSecure - EDR-Freeze

logsource.definition:
Requires Sysmon Event ID 10 (ProcessAccess) with CallTrace enabled.
Example sysmon config snippet with grouping, as logging individual ProcessAccess events can generate excessive logs:
<ProcessAccess onmatch="include">
    <Rule groupRelation="and">
    <TargetImage condition="end with">\MsMpEng.exe</TargetImage>
    <SourceImage condition="end with">\WerFaultSecure.exe</SourceImage>
    </Rule>
</ProcessAccess>

strategies.name: Detection of Defense Impairment through Disabled or Modified Tools across OS Platforms.

analytics.name: Analytic 1369
analytics.guidance: Detection of adversary behavior that disables or modifies security tools, including killing AV/EDR processes, stopping services, altering Sysmon registry keys, or tampering with exclusion lists. Defenders observe process/service termination, registry modification, and abnormal absence of expected telemetry.

tuning.description: List of expected administrative tools/processes to prevent false positives.
Defines correlation window linking process termination, registry edits, and service stoppage.
Customizable list of security service names per enterprise deployment.

analytics.name: Analytic 1370
analytics.guidance: Detects kill/systemctl/service commands against EDR, auditd, falco, osquery, rsyslog, journald, or agent processes; configuration edits disabling startup; module unload attempts; abrupt cessation of logs after privileged shell execution.

tuning.description: List of endpoint protection service names (varies across deployments).
Accounts permitted to legitimately stop or reconfigure services.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: systemctl stop, service stop, or kill -9 on security daemons (e.g., falcon-sensor, auditd)

log_sources.name: auditd:CONFIG_CHANGE
log_sources.channel: delete: Modification of systemd unit files or config for security agents

analytics.name: Analytic 1371
analytics.guidance: Detection of adversary disabling endpoint security tools by unloading launch agents/daemons, modifying configuration profiles, or disabling Gatekeeper/XProtect/logging settings, or removing endpoint agents followed by telemetry loss.

tuning.description: Detection correlation period for multiple security tool disable actions.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Execution of launchctl unload, kill, or removal of security agent daemons

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Modification of system configuration profiles affecting security tools

analytics.name: Analytic 1372
analytics.guidance: Correlates control-plane API actions disabling cloud-native monitoring or sensor agents (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Defender, monitoring agents), role abuse preceding disablement, or instance agent uninstall events

tuning.description: Customizable list of cloud provider API calls related to monitoring/alerting disablement.
Distinguishes adversary actions from authorized DevOps/CloudOps activities.

log_sources.name: AWS:CloudTrail
log_sources.channel: Delete* / Stop*: DeleteAlarms, StopLogging, or DisableMonitoring API calls

analytics.name: Analytic 1373
analytics.guidance: Detects disabling container runtime security controls, removing sidecar sensors, modifying seccomp/AppArmor profiles, mounting host proc/sys paths to interfere with host logging, or killing in-container monitoring agents.

tuning.description: Exclusion of namespaces where temporary deletion of monitoring tools is legitimate (e.g., staging).

log_sources.name: kubernetes:audit
log_sources.channel: kubectl delete or patch of security pods/admission controllers

analytics.name: Analytic 1374
analytics.guidance: Detects disabling AAA, syslog, SNMP traps, ACL logging, or security features on routers/switches/firewalls; correlates privileged login followed by configuration commit reducing visibility.

tuning.description: Reference configuration state for detecting unauthorized modifications.

log_sources.name: networkdevice:config
log_sources.channel: write: Startup configuration changes disabling security checks

log_sources.name: networkdevice:syslog
log_sources.channel: no logging host, no aaa new-model, no snmp-server, commit

analytics.name: Analytic 2044
analytics.guidance: Detects esxcli commands disabling syslog, firewall, lockdown mode, or stopping hostd/vpxa; correlates command execution with reduced forwarding activity.

log_sources.name: esxi:shell
log_sources.channel: esxcli system syslog config set/reload, services.sh restart/stop
